name: SWIR XBookmark
title: 10.17 BETA — PRIMARY ROOMS
friends_transport_policy: discover one authoritative open connection with code 85 -> 159, then use that same pinned connection for code 8/subcode 4 friend add and later code 85 verification
friends_packet_policy: official Android format confirmed: code 8, subcode 4, userId, username, isFriend=true
friends_ui_policy: show only friend nick and rooms; no APP/PC/SWIR/mobile badges or phone markers
rooms_policy: prefer code 159 rooms[]; fallback only to rooms actually observed in open connections while server confirmation is pending
legacy_policy: 10.17 isolates legacy Radar friend packets so only the Primary Transport core sends code 8/4 and code 85 during this beta
